svg.text: Milliseconds from measured current onset (not reset release)
Color identifies the firmware interval, not the component consuming that current. Acquisition and SD init overlap.
Transport includes MCU work, SD bus transfer and card waits; these traces do not separate the repeated block loops.
JS voltage is measured at its input. Current onset ≥20 mA; plateau boundary uses 1 ms bins. Image bytes were not reread in these runs.
